# Trumps nye toldbombe

**Feed**: store-penge  
**Published**: 2026-11-26  
**Market Sentiment**: Mixed

⏱️ **Time Horizon Key**: ST = <3 months | MT = 3-12 months | LT = >12 months

---

## Episode Thesis

This Danish StorPenge episode leads with Trump's new Section 301 tariffs on the EU, China and Southeast Asia, which the hosts expect to hit markets hard in the next few days before a likely 'TACO' climbdown within one to two months. They reverse-engineer what is priced into AI-infrastructure stocks: Nvidia trades at its lowest P/E in eight years even though Dell and HPE report full order books, so the market seems to be pricing in a tech crash that the fundamentals do not show. The episode also covers how to cope psychologically with drawdowns and mentions some ideas: UnitedHealth as a hedge against tech, European defence stocks, upcoming Polish IPOs and possible Ukraine peace talks.

---

## Universe Stocks

### 🟢 NVDA — Nvidia | **BUY** (Strong)

**Sentiment**: Positive | **Time Horizon**: LT  
**Confidence**: 85%

Tobias added 296k DKK and Nvidia is now 9.5% (820k DKK) of his portfolio. Lowest P/E in 8 years. The other host is also bullish.

#### Reasoning

Guest Tobias says the market prices in a big slowdown in AI data-center build-out, putting Nvidia on value-stock multiples (Target, Delta, Pepsi). He expects data-center demand to stay strong for 2-5 years because AI brings productivity gains. Dell and HPE order books support this. The co-host agrees the market implicitly prices a tech crash that is not visible in the fundamentals.

#### Sell Triggers

- if AI data-center demand clearly slows over the next 2-5 years
- if a wave of bankruptcies among AI/tech buyers materialises
- if hyperscaler capex is cut

> *"Nvidia, jeg har valgt at øge min position her i sidste uge, så valgte jeg at købe yderligere op i den her aktie, fordi jeg synes simpelthen, at prisen begynder på den lange bane at se så attraktiv ud."*

---

### 🟠 DELL — Dell | **WATCH** (Moderate)

**Sentiment**: Positive | **Time Horizon**: MT  
**Confidence**: 60%

Host very impressed by the report and the serious backlog. He finds it wild that the stock fell given the low multiples.

#### Reasoning

The co-host argues that Dell's multiples imply its server buyers would go bankrupt within the backlog period, which he sees no evidence for. A recovery likely needs a catalyst after the December rate decision and November inflation data.

#### Sell Triggers

- if a wave of bankruptcies among AI/tech server buyers appears
- if AI server cost inflation keeps squeezing margins

> *"Jeg var meget imponeret over det her delregnskab. Jeg synes, det er lidt vildt, at aktien ikke stiger på den baggrund. Det er en rigtig, rigtig seriøs backlog, de har liggende."*

---

### 🟢 UNH — UnitedHealth | **BUY** (Moderate)

**Sentiment**: Positive | **Time Horizon**: LT  
**Confidence**: 70%

Tobias made a further purchase. He thinks the regulatory proposal won't be as harsh as feared and sees it as a hedge against tech.

#### Reasoning

Guest Tobias expects US health-insurer regulation to be softened by long lawsuits and strong lobbying. He also values UnitedHealth as uncorrelated with AI and tech, which makes it a portfolio hedge.

#### Sell Triggers

- if US health regulation is enacted as harshly as proposed
- if Medicare Advantage reimbursement is cut materially

> *"Jeg har lige lavet et yderligere opkøb i United Health"*

---
